description: This file defines an internal sealed class 'StatusResponse' within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. The class encapsulates status flags indicating execution and waiting states, along with diagnostics information, and provides methods to access these statuses.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Encapsulates status flags indicating if a process is executing or waiting, along with diagnostics information.

methods.name: StatusResponse
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the status flags based on whether the process is executing or waiting, and accepts diagnostics information.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Overridden method to provide a string representation of the status including execution, waiting statuses, and diagnostics.
